prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 3:4 eye-level medium lifestyle editorial portrait of an adult woman standing waist-deep in a calm luxury resort infinity pool at golden hour. She has wet dark-brown hair slicked back, minimal natural makeup, sunglasses resting on her head, and wears an elegant opaque white one-piece swimsuit. She lifts her wet hair lightly with both hands, smiles naturally, and looks slightly off-camera. Include subtle water droplets, reflective pool water, palm trees, modern resort villas, and a clear sunset sky. Use low warm golden-hour light, soft rim illumination, gentle water reflections, natural skin texture, and shallow background blur. Keep the mood relaxed, refined, and non-sexualized. No text, logo, or watermark.
